reason: Plan v1 is rejected: the criteria do not enforce two of its own requirements, so validation could record a pass while the defect this task exists to fix is still in the tree. Keep requirements 1-8, files_to_modify and files_to_create exactly as they are; they are correct. Tighten the acceptance criteria as follows. (1) Requirement 3 demands the constitution section be labelled with CONSTITUTION_RELATIVE, and no criterion settles it: a reconciliation that resolves through constitution_path() but labels the heading with the absolute exported path passes all nine criteria. Add a case that exports ORCHESTRATOR_CONSTITUTION to a readable fixture outside the repo and asserts stdout carries the relative .ai/constitution.md label rather than the exported absolute path, and name that test in the AC-3 verify command. (2) AC-4 cannot settle the first half of its own statement. run_validation_check passes no env= to subprocess.run, so an acceptance criterion inherits the orchestrator environment, which never has ORCHESTRATOR_TASK_DIR set; unittest -v test_hook_resilience therefore passes with the run_hook inheritance bug of requirement 6 fully intact. Add a test that patches hostile ambient values into os.environ, with ORCHESTRATOR_TASK_DIR pointing at a decoy directory that contains valid implementation notes and a valid context block, and asserts a fixture-based case still resolves to its own tmpdir; name that test in its own material criterion so requirement 6 is independently enforced. (3) AC-5 claims no conflict syntax but py_compile only rejects markers that are syntax errors; a marker line inside a docstring or comment compiles cleanly. Append a scan to the AC-5 verify command that reads both hooks and exits non-zero if any line starts with a conflict marker prefix. (4) AC-1 can pass with the TASK-008 half reverted: under cwd resolution the fixture task directory is not found, implementation.md is missing, and the guard still exits 2 for an unrelated reason. Tighten AC-1 so the cwd tree holds complete decodable evidence and the diagnostic must name the undecodable artifact at the exported path, so a cwd-resolving regression fails on the message rather than passing on the exit code. (5) AC-2 relies on the emit() guarantee being carried by a source-level test inside the AC-4 module run, because a UTF-8 validation locale encodes a non-cp1252 blackboard fine. Either force a cp1252 stdout codec in the new AC-2 test subprocess so the criterion stands alone, or state in AC-2 that the explicit-encoding half is carried by that named source-level test. Do not widen the change: still exactly three files modified, none created, and _support.py untouched. The developer answers to Q-1 and Q-2 stand unchanged.
